inlines.v: ADUL'TERER, noun [Latin adulter.] 1. A man guilty of adultery; a man who has sexual commerce with any married woman, except his wife. [See Adultery.] 2. In scripture, an idolator. Ezekiel 23:37. 3. An apostate from the true faith, or one who violates his covenant engagements; a very wicked person. Jeremiah 9:2 and 23. 4. One devoted to earthly things. James 4:4.
